deviations.decision: The constitution's Quality Control article is the only QC policy and configuration source; the legacy steering keys are compatibility aliases that all resolve to it.

Requirements are spec.md and test cases live beside it: specs/<NNN-feature>/TEST-CASES-<NNN-feature>.md and TEST-DATA-<NNN-feature>.md. There is no Testing/Requirements or Testing/Manual_Test tree; pass explicit document paths to the skills.
Local reports only. Every automation invocation passes ado_mode: local; no external publishing or synchronization.
Browser test cases are validated live with link-qc-3c-validate-manual-test-cases-cli (playwright-cli); there is no MCP fallback. Non-browser scope uses the planned runner or a named tester.
